observations: Photo 0: an inline 4-cylinder petrol engine out of a vehicle, sitting in a parts yard among other used engines.
Photo 0: a small round badge on the cam cover that looks like the Volkswagen roundel; no engine code, displacement or part number is readable.
Photo 0: alternator, AC compressor, intake pipe, wiring harness with sensors and an orange oil dipstick handle are fitted.
Photo 0: the engine is covered in dust, grime and oily residue; it is plainly used, not new.
Photo 0: a faint watermark ('...ALVENTURE' or similar) runs across the alternator, a dealer's mark.

identity.kind: used Volkswagen 4-cylinder petrol engine, complete with ancillaries
read_from: photo 0 round badge on the cam cover

No engine code stamp shown; fitment cannot be read from photo 0.

risks.risk: Engine does not run, knocks, burns oil or has low compression
risks.proof: A clip of the engine running on a test stand or in a car from cold start, with the sound audible, plus a compression test reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, a core engine for rebuild

risks.risk: Engine code or displacement differs from the claimed Passat 2.0
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the stamped engine code on the block
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest value Volkswagen 4-cylinder petrol engine

risks.risk: Cracked block or head, or warped head from overheating
risks.proof: Close-ups of all sides of the block and head, and of the oil filler cap underside

risks.risk: Missing ECU, harness parts or ancillaries at collection
risks.proof: A fresh photo of all sides of the engine with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare engine without ECU or ancillaries

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty do not exist
risks.proof: A photo of the receipt and warranty document

proof_requests: Clip of the engine running from cold start with sound
Close-up of the stamped engine code on the block
Fresh photo of the engine with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give
Photo of the receipt and warranty document
Close-ups of the block, head and oil filler cap underside
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used Volkswagen 4-cylinder petrol engine, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-running core of unconfirmed engine code. The 'like new' claim is contradicted by the grime in photo 0 and the receipt and running claims are unproven, so none of them raise the price.
